jobs.title: Director, Head of Creative
jobs.description:
About Us

Twitch is the world’s biggest live streaming service, with global communities built around gaming, entertainment, music, sports, cooking, and more. It is where thousands of communities come together for whatever, every day.

We’re about community, inside and out. You’ll find coworkers who are eager to team up, collaborate, and smash (or elegantly solve) problems together. We’re on a quest to empower live communities, so if this sounds good to you, see what we’re up to on LinkedIn and X, and discover the projects we’re solving on our Blog. Be sure to explore our Interviewing Guide to learn how to ace our interview process.

About The Role

As the Director, Head of Creative, you will shape and scale our global creative strategy, leading a high-performing team to deliver compelling, community-focused brand experiences. Reporting directly to the Chief Marketing Officer (CMO), you will partner with cross-functional leaders to drive innovation, optimize creative operations through scalable, AI-assisted processes, and ensure consistent, high-quality brand representation across global markets. This role requires a data-driven approach to strategy, a passion for fostering an inclusive team culture, and the ability to champion creative initiatives that raise the quality bar, while resonating with our diverse community of streamers and viewers.

You can work from San Francisco, CA; Los Angeles, CA; Irvine, CA; Seattle, WA; or New York, NY.

You Will:

Lead and develop: Build and mentor a high-performing creative team, fostering a culture of psychological safety, inclusivity, and continuous feedback.
Drive creative strategy and long-term vision: Partner with cross-functional leaders to align business objectives with long-term creative vision.
Oversee brand identity: Maintain global visual and verbal brand standards across all markets to ensure consistency.
Lead agency partnerships: Direct external partners and agencies to deliver creative excellence under tight timelines.
Influence senior leadership: Champion creative initiatives to senior stakeholders through data-driven storytelling to secure alignment.
Champion innovation: Stay current with industry trends and technology to elevate the brand and inspire breakthrough work.

You Have:

Leadership experience: 10+ years in creative direction, marketing, or advertising leadership, with proven success managing teams of managers.
Strategic vision: Ability to design and execute team structures and strategies that navigate ambiguity and meet business objectives.
Communication skills: Exceptional ability to synthesize and present complex creative concepts to executive audiences.
Global Brand and Agency Management: Proven track record of managing global brand standards and high-value external agency relationships to deliver results.
Data-driven mindset: Experience using performance insights and market trends to inform creative decisions and campaign strategies.
Education/Experience: Bachelor’s degree in a design-related field or equivalent practical experience.
Portfolio: A portfolio or case studies demonstrating strategic creative leadership, brand building, and campaign impact is required.

Bonus Points

Proven experience building creative strategies where the user/creator voice is the primary brand asset, effectively navigating the balance between corporate standards and community authenticity.

Medical, Dental, Vision & Disability Insurance
401(k)
Maternity & Parental Leave
Flexible PTO
Amazon Employee Discount

jobs.title: Art Director
jobs.description:
Position Summary

Reporting to the Director, Social Media and Creative Services, the Art Director serves as the creative lead responsible for advancing and safeguarding the Stony Brook Medicine brand across all print, digital and environmental touchpoints. This role combines strategic creative leadership with hands-on design execution, ensuring that every visual communication reflects the organization's mission, values and standards of excellence. The Art Director oversees the design team, providing creative direction, mentorship and inspiration while fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration and continuous growth. They manage creative workflows, prioritize projects and allocate resources to ensure timely delivery of high-quality work across multiple service lines, departments and stakeholders. Working closely with the Director, Social Media and Creative Services and the broader Marketing and Communications team, the Art Director helps shape and execute integrated marketing and communications strategies, translating complex concepts into compelling visual solutions that engage diverse audiences. This role leads the development of sophisticated and creative print, digital, environmental and multimedia communications that strengthen brand awareness, enhance patient experience and support organizational goals. As the primary steward of the Stony Brook Medicine visual identity, the Art Director oversees design standards, typography, illustration and creative execution across the health system. They provide expert guidance on brand and licensing compliance, ensuring both internal and external partners consistently uphold established brand standards while identifying opportunities to evolve and elevate the brand. The Art Director serves as the principal liaison to freelance designers, guiding creative development, ensuring consistency across campaigns and overseeing the adaptation of assets for various platforms and audiences. They stay at the forefront of design innovation and emerging technologies, including AI-powered creative tools, to continually enhance the efficiency, effectiveness and impact of the health system's creative output.

Duties of an Art Director may include the following but are not limited to:

Lead the creative vision and execution for Stony Brook Medicine's visual communications across print, digital, environmental and multimedia platforms.
Champion, maintain and evolve the Stony Brook Medicine brand identity, ensuring consistency and excellence across all touchpoints.
Establish and uphold best practices in design, typography, illustration and visual storytelling.
Educate internal stakeholders, external partners and vendors on brand standards, licensing requirements and visual identity guidelines.
Review and provide direction on licensing submissions to ensure compliance with brand standards.
Supervise, mentor and develop a team of designers, fostering creativity, accountability and professional growth.
Manage project intake, workload distribution and resource planning, aligning assignments with team expertise, capacity and deadlines.
Review creative briefs and project requests to ensure strategic objectives, audience needs and project requirements are clearly defined.
Provide ongoing creative feedback and quality control throughout the design process.
Monitor project timelines and proactively address challenges to ensure deadlines and quality standards are consistently achieved.
Conceptualize, design and execute high-profile marketing, communications and branding materials from initial strategy through final production.
Translate complex healthcare information and data into visually compelling and accessible graphics, infographics and presentations.
Design and oversee production of signage and environmental graphics for outpatient facilities and other health system locations.
Perform advanced image editing and photo retouching as needed.
Ensure all final deliverables meet technical and ADA specifications and are optimized for both print and digital distribution.
Partner closely with Marketing and Communications leadership, clinicians, administrators and other stakeholders to develop creative solutions that meet business objectives.
Serve as a trusted advisor on design and brand-related matters, diplomatically resolving challenges and aligning stakeholders around creative recommendations.
Collaborate with freelance designers, photographers and creative vendors to ensure high-quality work and seamless execution.
Work with the agency of record to guide campaign development, ensure adherence to brand standards and facilitate the successful transfer and production of campaign assets.
Stay informed on emerging trends, technologies and best practices in design, marketing, animation, AI and creative production.
Identify opportunities to improve creative workflows, enhance team capabilities and elevate the overall quality and effectiveness of the organization's creative output.
Promote the adoption of innovative tools and processes that support efficiency, creativity and strategic impact.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree and a minimum of eight (8) years of professional design experience.
Demonstrated leadership experience managing, mentoring or directing creative professionals and projects.
Advanced proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud, including InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop, After Effects and Adobe Firefly, as well as Google Slides and PowerPoint, all in a Mac-based environment.
Expert understanding of design principles, branding systems, typography, color theory and visual communication.
Strong knowledge of print production, digital design, accessibility standards (ADA Compliance) and file preparation best practices.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and competing deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
Excellent written, verbal and presentation communication skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate across all organizational levels.
Demonstrated curiosity and proficiency with emerging technologies and a commitment to continuous professional development.

Preferred Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Fine Arts, Graphic Design, Visual Communications or a related discipline.
Experience with Monday.com or similar project and workflow management platform.

Special Notes:
Resume/CV should be included with the online application.

Posting Overview:
This position will remain posted until filled or for a maximum of 90 days. An initial review of all applicants will occur two weeks from the posting date. Candidates are advised on the application that for full consideration, applications must be received before the initial review date (which is within two weeks of the posting date).

If within the initial review no candidate was selected to fill the position posted, additional applications will be considered for the posted position; however, the posting will close once a finalist is identified, and at minimal, two weeks after the initial posting date. Please note, that if no candidate were identified and hired within 90 days from initial posting, the posting would close for review, and possibly reposted at a later date.

All Hospital positions may be subject to changes in pass days and shifts as necessary.
This position may require the wearing of respiratory protection, which may prohibit the wearing of facial hair.
This function/position may be designated as “essential.” This means that when the Hospital is faced with an institutional emergency, employees in such positions may be required to remain at their work location or to report to work to protect, recover, and continue operations at Stony Brook Medicine, Stony Brook University Hospital and related facilities.

Prior to start date, the selected candidate must meet the following requirements:

Successfully complete pre-employment physical examination and obtain medical clearance from Stony Brook Medicine's Employee Health Services*
Complete electronic reference check with a minimum of three (3) professional references.
Successfully complete a 4 panel drug screen*
Meet Regulatory Requirements for pre-employment screenings.
Provide a copy of any required New York State license(s)/certificate(s).

Failure to comply with any of the above requirements could result in a delayed start date and/or revocation of the employment offer.

The hiring department will be responsible for any fee incurred for examination.

jobs.title: Creative Director, Event Design
jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

Brand Studio lays the foundations that help Stripe accelerate. We do this by creating, evolving, and maintaining Stripe's high-quality, versatile, and forward-looking brand design systems, experiences, and advertising campaigns. We sweat the details. We make it seem effortless. The Experiential team is responsible for bringing Stripe's brand to life in the real world—from flagship events and industry conferences to internal summits and curated partner experiences. This is a team that operates at the intersection of creativity, strategy, and production.

What you'll do

As Creative Director, Event Design, you will lead a team of talented designers and set the creative direction for all of Stripe's event and experience design. You are an inspiring leader and a sharp creative director—someone who can zoom out to define a cohesive creative vision, and zoom in to give precise, actionable feedback. You partner closely with event marketers, brand leaders, producers, and executive stakeholders to ensure every Stripe experience is cohesive, intentional, and unmistakably on-brand. You care deeply about your team's craft, their growth, and the culture they work within.

Responsibilities

Lead, manage, and grow a team of brand and experiential designers—setting clear expectations, fostering a culture of craft, and creating an environment where designers do their best work
Own the creative direction for Stripe's experiential design output: event design systems, digital and environmental graphics, keynote design concepting, and brand activations
Partner with the Experiential Creative Director and Brand Studio leadership to define the strategic creative vision for how Stripe shows up in the world
Champion creative quality—establish and maintain a high bar across all deliverables, from concept through execution
Build and evolve Stripe's experiential design system: scalable standards, templates, and creative frameworks that work globally across teams and events
Oversee relationships with external agencies, contractors, production studios, and vendor partners—aligning on creative direction and ensuring quality delivery
Collaborate cross-functionally with corporate events and product marketing, product design, brand design, and executive communications teams
Recruit, hire, and onboard design talent to build out the team as the function grows
Develop direct reports through regular 1:1s, structured feedback, career development conversations, and thoughtful performance calibration
Represent the Experiential design function in leadership forums and cross-functional planning processes

Requirements

10+ years of relevant design experience, including 3+ years managing and growing a team of designers
Proven track record of creative direction for high-profile brand design and experiences, and events at a global scale
Strong people leadership skills—you have developed design talent, navigated performance challenges, and built healthy, high-output teams
Deep understanding of experiential design: environmental graphics, stage and scenic design, digital/physical brand integration, wayfinding, and event identity systems
Ability to design and art direct across a wide range of surface areas (digital, physical, motion, communication) and tooling (Figma, Keynote, Adobe Creative Cloud, and AI tools)
Strong executive presence—you can present and defend creative decisions to senior leaders with confidence and clarity
Ability to simultaneously manage creative quality and team health—you know when to coach, when to redirect, and when to roll up your sleeves
Systems-thinking approach with a track record of building scalable creative frameworks and extending shared patterns across a global brand
Experience managing agency relationships and large-scale external production partners
Strong track record of influencing without authority across marketing, product, and executive stakeholders
Ability to balance creative ambition and operational rigor, consistently shipping world-class work on deadline and on budget
Persuasive and humble, with a drive to seek feedback, and model the creative and collaborative behaviors that make great teams
Excellent communication and presentation skills—equally comfortable writing a creative brief and presenting work to a range of stakeholders
Highly detail-oriented, with a drive for perfection in every experience you ship
Passionate about Stripe's mission, dedicated to a user-first mindset, and grounded in data and business context

Hybrid work at Stripe

This role is available either in an office or a remote location (35+ miles or 56+ km from a Stripe office).

In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This hits a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility about how to do this in a way that makes sense for individuals and their teams.

Working remotely at Stripe

A remote location is defined as being 35 miles (56 kilometers) or more from one of our offices. While you would be welcome to come into the office for team/business meetings, on-sites, meet-ups, and events, our expectation is you would regularly work from home rather than a Stripe office. Stripe does not cover the cost of relocating to a remote location. We encourage you to apply for roles that match the location where you currently live or plan to live.

Pay and benefits

The annual US base salary range for this role is $214,400 - $321,600. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the US may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.

Additional benefits for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; 401(k) plan; medical, dental, and vision benefits; and wellness stipends.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

Apply now

Please find our California applicant personal information notice here.

new_jobs.title: Creative Director, Event Design
new_jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

Brand Studio lays the foundations that help Stripe accelerate. We do this by creating, evolving, and maintaining Stripe's high-quality, versatile, and forward-looking brand design systems, experiences, and advertising campaigns. We sweat the details. We make it seem effortless. The Experiential team is responsible for bringing Stripe's brand to life in the real world—from flagship events and industry conferences to internal summits and curated partner experiences. This is a team that operates at the intersection of creativity, strategy, and production.

What you'll do

As Creative Director, Event Design, you will lead a team of talented designers and set the creative direction for all of Stripe's event and experience design. You are an inspiring leader and a sharp creative director—someone who can zoom out to define a cohesive creative vision, and zoom in to give precise, actionable feedback. You partner closely with event marketers, brand leaders, producers, and executive stakeholders to ensure every Stripe experience is cohesive, intentional, and unmistakably on-brand. You care deeply about your team's craft, their growth, and the culture they work within.

Responsibilities

Lead, manage, and grow a team of brand and experiential designers—setting clear expectations, fostering a culture of craft, and creating an environment where designers do their best work
Own the creative direction for Stripe's experiential design output: event design systems, digital and environmental graphics, keynote design concepting, and brand activations
Partner with the Experiential Creative Director and Brand Studio leadership to define the strategic creative vision for how Stripe shows up in the world
Champion creative quality—establish and maintain a high bar across all deliverables, from concept through execution
Build and evolve Stripe's experiential design system: scalable standards, templates, and creative frameworks that work globally across teams and events
Oversee relationships with external agencies, contractors, production studios, and vendor partners—aligning on creative direction and ensuring quality delivery
Collaborate cross-functionally with corporate events and product marketing, product design, brand design, and executive communications teams
Recruit, hire, and onboard design talent to build out the team as the function grows
Develop direct reports through regular 1:1s, structured feedback, career development conversations, and thoughtful performance calibration
Represent the Experiential design function in leadership forums and cross-functional planning processes

Requirements

10+ years of relevant design experience, including 3+ years managing and growing a team of designers
Proven track record of creative direction for high-profile brand design and experiences, and events at a global scale
Strong people leadership skills—you have developed design talent, navigated performance challenges, and built healthy, high-output teams
Deep understanding of experiential design: environmental graphics, stage and scenic design, digital/physical brand integration, wayfinding, and event identity systems
Ability to design and art direct across a wide range of surface areas (digital, physical, motion, communication) and tooling (Figma, Keynote, Adobe Creative Cloud, and AI tools)
Strong executive presence—you can present and defend creative decisions to senior leaders with confidence and clarity
Ability to simultaneously manage creative quality and team health—you know when to coach, when to redirect, and when to roll up your sleeves
Systems-thinking approach with a track record of building scalable creative frameworks and extending shared patterns across a global brand
Experience managing agency relationships and large-scale external production partners
Strong track record of influencing without authority across marketing, product, and executive stakeholders
Ability to balance creative ambition and operational rigor, consistently shipping world-class work on deadline and on budget
Persuasive and humble, with a drive to seek feedback, and model the creative and collaborative behaviors that make great teams
Excellent communication and presentation skills—equally comfortable writing a creative brief and presenting work to a range of stakeholders
Highly detail-oriented, with a drive for perfection in every experience you ship
Passionate about Stripe's mission, dedicated to a user-first mindset, and grounded in data and business context

Hybrid work at Stripe

This role is available either in an office or a remote location (35+ miles or 56+ km from a Stripe office).

In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This hits a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility about how to do this in a way that makes sense for individuals and their teams.

Working remotely at Stripe

A remote location is defined as being 35 miles (56 kilometers) or more from one of our offices. While you would be welcome to come into the office for team/business meetings, on-sites, meet-ups, and events, our expectation is you would regularly work from home rather than a Stripe office. Stripe does not cover the cost of relocating to a remote location. We encourage you to apply for roles that match the location where you currently live or plan to live.

Pay and benefits

The annual US base salary range for this role is $214,400 - $321,600. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the US may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.

Additional benefits for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; 401(k) plan; medical, dental, and vision benefits; and wellness stipends.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

Apply now
